P1-3.description: Real, wired onboarding upload action (app/[companyId]/onboarding/documents/actions.ts) bypasses all content-hash dedup by calling uploadAndChunkDocument directly instead of the existing, tested lib/connectors/upload-connector.ts's uploadDocumentThroughIngestion wrapper.

P1-10.description: An in-text citation shaped like a real heading is accepted by stage-structure.ts as a genuine top-level SECTION raw node, corrupting the global rank-stack and misattaching later real clauses to the spurious node.
candidateDesigns: Plausibility gate before a same/shallower-rank pop (smallest blast radius)
Two-pass parse: validate ARTICLE/SECTION raws against numbering-sequence/position sanity before clause-tree region slicing
Confidence-tagged raws with deferred acceptance (most surgical, needs a StructuralNode shape change)
P1-10.boundedDetectionAlreadyLive: SECTION_NUMBER_SEQUENCE_ANOMALY (INFO, non-gating) health check already exists and fires 4x on CONMED, 27x on DSGR - detection only, does not correct the misattachment.

P1-11.description: No supersession marker on structural nodes; consumers that read nodes directly (lib/contract-model/compiler/semantic-verification/source-inventory.ts, lib/contract-model/compiler/discovery/pass-a-signals.ts) rather than going through amendment/operative-state.ts can treat historically-superseded text as current.

definitionFallbacks.description: 3 additional call sites with the same cross-document no-documentId getDefinition fallback pattern that P0-2's fix (Phase 3F.1.4 Workstream B) addressed elsewhere: lib/contract-model/compiler/semantic/tools.ts, lib/contract-model/compiler/amendment/pipeline.ts, lib/contract-model/compiler/amendment/independent-verification.ts.

sourceTraceSuspicion.description: getRuleSourceTrace's definedTermRefs lookup (service.ts) appears to assume a stored stableKey format but is populated with raw term names by persistContractRules - a possible latent mismatch, noticed but never investigated.

operativeStateStructuralHealthGap.description: operative-state.ts never calls index.healthDiagnostics() anywhere - a section already flagged INVALID_SOURCE_SPAN/ERROR by the structural index can still be confidently reported OPERATIVE_STATE_RESOLVED. Documented and reproduced in tests/foundation-audit/combined-failures.test.ts's first describe block.
